name: corpus
description: Connect saved questions and relationships to their exact current sources.

interface.shortDescription: Use shared Context and continue local Work files
interface.longDescription: Corpus organizes reusable Context, indexed Sources, and editable Work files into Spaces. It owns source capture, revision and projection identity, anchors, search, and exact reading; the Document Files plugin supplies document parsing and OCR through a read-only process boundary. Chat starts from saved Context and reads exact current Source text only when needed.
capabilities: Indexed Source search and exact reading
Version-checked file replacement, deletion, and restore
defaultPrompt: Show my Corpus Spaces and their available Context and Connections.
Use the relevant Context, then read only the exact Source text still needed.
Continue the Current File in my Corpus Work Connection.
